mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a sweltering seventy-six degrees at Harriet Park tonight, feeling more like a sticky eighty. Under this dark new moon, keep your eyes on the ground because there are no space station sightings tonight. In city news, creative local students should submit their custom designs for the official I Voted sticker contest by July twenty-second. In police news, officers attempted to stop a motorcycle without a license plate, but the driver sped off blowing through red lights. Finally, Culver's is closed right now but opens tomorrow morning at ten AM. Sleep tight and dream of tomorrow's Snickers Swirl!
